notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
description:
At the beginning of your end step, Unstoppable Plan triggers.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Unstoppable Plan's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Unstoppable Plan's ability, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Repeat from step 2.
